scenarios.description: All 19 currently experimental animals have authored project-entry and experiment-start dates, consistent across Core, Project Track, Medi Track and Reports; prior completed periods are retained.
Canonical identity, references, roles and experimental limits for all active and archived animals.
Weight histories for Callitrix, Macaca, Papio and Mus through the latest scientific record.
Denethor, Boromir and Faramir retain biological donor and surrogate parentage.
Two linked egg retrieval, sperm collection, embryo transfer, verification and birth chains.
Megan: low oocyte yield and no embryos; no fabricated transfer.
Lauren: low embryo development, one transferred embryo and a verified pregnancy ending in abortion.
Two fully linked transfers with negative pregnancy verification.
Two fully linked transfers with positive verification followed by abortion.

Legolas retains Svetlana/Thranduil biological parentage and Olga as surrogate. Svetlana's collection is 1 October 2025, Thranduil's existing sample is 2 October, Olga's corrected transfer is 10 October; birth stays 4 March 2026.
Three 28-day cycles; one reading per animal/kind/calendar day; post-PGF response retains its sample number.

Every transferred embryo links to an egg retrieval and an identified Denethor or Thranduil sperm sample; sperm is collected one day after eggs; transfer is 6-9 days after sperm collection/fertilization (current examples: 7-9 days after eggs, 6-8 after sperm).

Every egg collection and sperm sample has complete stage metrics. Tiffany/Boromir has four transferred and two frozen linked embryos, retaining all six produced and biological parentage. In-vivo MII is limited to 0-2 per collection and never produces embryos; all 21 embryos arise from IVF-fertilized in-vitro MII. Collection-only/unused samples have no fabricated fertilization or embryo links.
Four experimental Ringbearer mice preserve their surgery events and former Shire membership.
Eight founder pairs, five planned generations, 1-2 litters per pair, 10-12 young per litter, limited selected breeders and at most 500 mice in total.

Every mouse, including Frodo, Sam and Elanor, has a surname inherited through the father's line; spouses keep their own lineage. Hobbit and ASCII Portuguese given names use varied descriptive monikers to distinguish repeated given-name/surname combinations, never numeric offspring suffixes.
Sam remains Elanor's father; Sam/Rosie's complete litter is the explicit generation-6 exception.
Study pair cages, ordinary breeding cages and same-sex groups of at most five; Bilbo's deliberate single-cage witness.
Four explicitly pinned animal observations and resolutions, independent of population sort order.
Five projects, seven synthetic users; job-derived permissions and separate organizational versus housing Units.
No Heritage-owned dummy or real-animal Core shadow in the shipped seed.
